dataIsolation: A uniquely generated QA account was created through the production UI. An independent native Bearer session inspected actual server state. No existing account was deleted or its workspace reset.
checks: Production SeraRoot restores authentication and displays login
UI registration opens first-use preferences and calendar setup
First-use completion is persisted in the server workspace
UI creates a five-minute inbox task without silently scheduling a time block
Starting focus persists a running session for that exact task ID
Pausing persists elapsed seconds; paused wall time does not increase them
Resuming and finishing persist a real focus record and matching task actualSeconds
Finishing a focus session alone does not mark its task done
Explicit completion persists done status without losing actual focus history
UI logout and login restore exactly the created task and focus record
Password-confirmed UI deletion removes only this QA account
Independent previously authenticated session receives HTTP 401 after account deletion
No unhandled Flutter UI exception remains
classification: Real Flutter UI and native storage against a real API on the specified emulator; no business or network success was mocked and no paid AI was invoked by this test.
fixesVerified: First-use routing follows loaded account state instead of a single initialization callback
boundaries: This integration-test APK is not the final signed release APK; release installation is recorded separately
API24 and API33+ are not covered by this API32 emulator
Natural human speech recognition accuracy is not established by this business test
